reading.title: Minutes of the regular meeting of September 9, 2025

candidates.quote: The Economic Development Director said the applicant offers eighteen income-restricted apartments out of ninety.
The applicant's representative stated that the company is willing to keep the restrictions in place until the end of 2055.
A motion to grant the ten-year assessment freeze failed on a vote of 3 to 4.
